# What is Standard Operating Procedure? (SOP)
SOP, in its most simplest form, is how Nanotrasen expects Command and Crew to run station facilities.
Deviations from SOP, while not a violation of space law, may be grounds for discipline and/or termination of contract. Given circumstances and context, Nanotrasen expects Command and Crew to prioritize safety the of Station over procedure. Non-standard situation are not expected to be covered by a [bold]Standard[/bold] Operating Procedure. SOP can be adapted to new circumstances as required.
The decision to punish a crew member for breach of SOP is decided by the relevant Head of Staff. In the case of the Captain, Central Command is the only authority capable of determining if there was a break of SOP and the subsequent punishment.
Due to SOP being newly implemented in this sector, only Command members have explicit Nanotrasen created SOP's. At this current moment, Heads of Staff are permitted to create their own department based SOP's for non Command Crew and submit them to Central Command via fax.
